AcceptResourceShareInvitation.description_zh: 资源使用者调用AcceptResourceShareInvitation接受资源共享邀请

AssociateResourceShare.description_en: Associates shared resources or principals with a resource share
AssociateResourceShare.description_zh: 为共享单元关联共享资源或资源使用者

AssociateResourceSharePermission.description_en: Associates permissions with a resource share
AssociateResourceSharePermission.description_zh: 调用AssociateResourceSharePermission为共享单元关联共享权限

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Transfers a resource share from one resource group to another
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 将共享单元从一个资源组转移到另外一个资源组

CheckSharingWithResourceDirectoryStatus.description_en: Checks the status of resource sharing within a resource directory
CheckSharingWithResourceDirectoryStatus.description_zh: 检查基于组织共享的状态

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where the Resource Sharing service is available
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询支持资源共享的地域

DisassociateResourceShare.description_en: Disassociates shared resources or principals from a resource share
DisassociateResourceShare.description_zh: 为共享单元移除共享资源或资源使用者

DisassociateResourceSharePermission.description_en: Disassociates a permission from a resource share. You can disassociate a permission from a resource share only if the resource share does not contain resources of the type indicated by the permission
DisassociateResourceSharePermission.description_zh: 调用DisassociateResourceSharePermission为共享单元解除共享权限。当共享单元下权限对应的资源类型没有关联具体资源时，才允许从共享单元中删除权限

EnableSharingWithResourceDirectory.description_en: Enables resource sharing for a resource directory
EnableSharingWithResourceDirectory.description_zh: 启用资源目录组织共享

GetPermission.description_en: Queries the information about a permission
GetPermission.description_zh: 调用GetPermission查询共享权限信息

ListPermissionVersions.description_en: Queries the versions of a permission
ListPermissionVersions.description_zh: 调用ListPermissionVersions查询指定共享权限名称的版本信息

ListPermissions.description_en: Queries the information about the default permission
ListPermissions.description_zh: 调用ListPermissions查询默认共享权限信息

ListResourceShareAssociations.description_en: Lists the resources or principals that are associated with a resource share
ListResourceShareAssociations.description_zh: 查询共享单元中关联资源或资源使用者的记录

ListResourceShareInvitations.description_en: Queries the resource sharing invitations that you have received
ListResourceShareInvitations.description_zh: 资源使用者调用ListResourceShareInvitations查询自己收到的资源共享邀请信息

ListResourceSharePermissions.description_en: Queries the permissions that are associated with a resource share
ListResourceSharePermissions.description_zh: 调用ListResourceSharePermissions查询共享单元中关联权限的记录

ListSharedResources.description_en: Queries the resources you share with other accounts or the resources other accounts share with you
ListSharedResources.description_zh: 查询共享的资源列表或者其他账号共享的资源列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags attached to one or more resource shares
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询共享单元绑定的标签

RejectResourceShareInvitation.description_zh: 资源使用者调用RejectResourceShareInvitation拒绝资源共享邀请

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from one or more resource shares

UpdateResourceShare.description_en: Modifies the information of a resource share
